annotation_protocol.goal: independent gold fact annotation of source paragraphs for precision/recall of extraction (not QA)
instruction: Read title and paragraph. List every explicitly reported fact.

Each fact: subject, relation (Wikidata-style, specific), object (short unambiguous name), qualifiers (only claim-bound context: time, place, role, polarity, modality, attribution, condition, unit, approximation).
No world knowledge, no transitive consequences, no artificial inverses.
Split coordination into separate facts; resolve pronouns only when unambiguous.
Mark facts that need qualifiers to be correct: must_have_qualifier=true.
Also list 'missed_by_systems' claims after comparing with system outputs (fill during review, not before).
annotation_protocol.how_to_fill: copy data/gold/gold_template.json -> data/gold/<input_id>.gold.json and fill 'triplets'; keep selection file data/gold/gold_selection.json unchanged
annotation_protocol.agreement: no inter-annotator agreement available yet; do not report any
